name: Hong Kong quotes read right, a portfolio opens in value order, and listings abroad say what they read
body:
## Highlights

- **Hong Kong quotes read right.** A counter that did not trade shows its move against the right session, HKEX's own five-digit codes like `00700.HK` and `03042.HK` work, and index moves name the session they compare with. (#2594)
- **A portfolio opens in value order.** A value-sorted portfolio no longer paints alphabetically for a few seconds before it reorders, and a large one uses less memory. (#2598)
- **Listings abroad say what they read.** Holders and supply chain for a Shanghai or Shenzhen line with nothing on record say which sources were read, instead of a bare `NO_DATA`. (#2593)
- **India's special sessions.** The calendar knows NSE and BSE's Muhurat session, so its moves compare with the last regular close. (#2600)

## Also in this release

- `MEMB` says when a fund is not covered and points to its fund facts, and its Changes tab says why it is empty. (#2600)
- A screenshot of a long list ends on its last whole row and says how many rows it shows. (#2600)
- `portfolio show` totals the day's move. (#2594)
- A new alert says when its level already holds, and the examples use levels that are not met yet.
- The offline docs match the live docs. (#2599)

[Full diff](https://github.com/gloom-sh/gloomberb/compare/v0.20.6...v0.20.7)
